The '''MG7-A proton torpedo''' was a model of [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] produced by [[Krupx Munitions/Legends|Krupx Munitions]] and commonly used aboard [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
The MG7-A was a model of [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] manufactured by [[Krupx Munitions/Legends|Krupx Munitions]]. A small, conically shaped munition, the MG7-A was launched from [[Proton torpedo launcher/Legends|launchers]] mounted on [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. The [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] was built around the [[proton-scattering energy warhead]], which was covered with a number of [[energy envelope projector]]s. The projectors sheathed the [[Missile/Legends|projectile]] in a protective shield that prevented premature detonation from near-collisions with debris and weapons fire.<ref name="EGWT" />

A [[homing sensor]] tipped the [[Warhead/Legends|warhead]], allowing the torpedo to home in on its target. The guidance system had a margin of error of less than three [[Meter/Legends|meters]], although if the torpedo lost its target it sometimes accidentally locked onto the nearest ship within range. An [[Ignition Charge]] sat under the homing [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] above the warhead. Below the warhead, a [[Propellant Cylinder]] provided thrust. The bottom of the weapon featured an arming stud and [[Dataport/Legends|dataport]], as well as [[Magnetic clamp/Legends|magnetic clamps]].<ref name="EGWT" /> The torpedo had an optimum range of two hundred meters, and a maximum range of six hundred meters.<ref name="NEGWT" />

==History==
[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] fired two MG7-A proton torpedoes into the [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|thermal exhaust port]] on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], resulting in the destruction of the [[battle station]].
